title: Air Force lieutenant colonel makes Marines sign an NDA and threatens execution
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Air Force lieutenant colonel makes Marines sign an NDA and threatens execution, about 2009-2010 at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then um he told me flat out that if you talk about this, you can go to prison or you can be executed over it.

plain: A former Marine named Michael Herrera says that around 2009 or 2010, at Camp Hansen, a Marine base on the Japanese island of Okinawa, an Air Force lieutenant colonel had him and other Marines sign a non-disclosure agreement, a promise of secrecy, tied to a top secret mission in Indonesia where Herrera says he saw a huge craft in the jungle. According to Herrera, the officer told him flat out that talking about it could mean prison or even execution, which, if true, shows how hard someone was working to keep the sighting quiet.
